'''Oon Garat''' was a [[Color/Legends|gray]]-skinned [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Zodoh]] during the [[Aquilaris campaign]] of the [[Republic Dark Age]]. She served aboard his fighter carrier flagship ''[[Voracious]]'' and met her demise during the [[Battle of Darkknell]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] when she was exposed and swept into zero gravity space.

==Biography==
Oon Garat was present during a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] conference with several Sith Lords including [[Odion]], [[Arkadia Calimondra]] and [[Malakite]] aboard Zodoh's flagship ''[[Voracious]]''. During the meeting, her Hutt master outlined his plans of selling slaves and munitions to the Sith Lords in exchange for their cooperation. She was also aware of his plans to use [[Stormdriver]]s to create artificial floods on [[Aquilaris Minor|Aquilaris]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].

Following the meeting, she expressed her doubts that the Sith could not be trusted. Zodoh replied that the Sith could be trusted to covet and were not aware of his true intentions. Garat reported that the Stormdriver had collected the needed data on Aquilaris prior to its destruction by [[Jenn Devaad]]'s [[Devil Squadron]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] during the [[Battle of Capital Cay]]. Satisfied that his old Republic enemy Devaad had arrived too late to stop his plans, he ordered Oon Garat to send a courier to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] with orders to deploy the Stormdrivers. Zodoh realized that the Sith would not tolerate a Hutt competitor but boasted he would defeat them and claim control of the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]].

Oon Garat was also present during the [[Battle of Darkknell]] where she handed Zodoh a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] during a duel with Kerra. She was subsequently killed when Jenn's starfighter shot open the warship's control dome, exposing the crew to zero gravity space.

==Behind the scenes==
Oon Garat was first introduced as a minor supporting antagonist in the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Deluge|''Deluge story arc'']] of the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'']] comic series which debuted on [[August]] [[2011]]. [[John Jackson Miller]] developed her story background while he was drawn by [[Ivan Rodriguez]] and colored by [[Michael Atiyeh]].
